title: Vulnerabilities in twofactor_gauthenticator plugin for Roundcube
content_md: CERT Polska has received a report about 3 vulnerabilities (from CVE-2026-107145 to CVE-2026-107147) found in twofactor_gauthenticator plugin for Roundcube. Article Link: Vulnerabilities in twofactor_gauthenticator plugin for Roundcube | CERT Polska
